summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (or reuses an existing bun on PATH) and then uses execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style script (string-array shuffling, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose behavior cannot be inferred from source. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the package's advertised web-search purpose, is invoked outside the Node.js resolver so tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code will miss it, and setup.mjs itself is also renamed/obfuscated, inconsistent with the small readable TypeScript in src/. On npm install, the payload executes arbitrary code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
